epistemic_assessments.rationale: The design authority pack and the risk forum pack share data flows, retention position, model performance summary and cohort breakdown, prepared separately by the same team at approximately 6 person-days per month.
The packs were cut on 2026-02-04 and 2026-02-11 respectively, so the two forums assessed the same change against different evidence vintages.

payload.statement: Substantially the same evidence is assembled twice for two forums, at different cut-off dates, by the same delivery team.
payload.scope: Technology Design Authority and Risk Acceptance Forum pack preparation.
recommended_next_evidence: Whether either forum requires a cut-off date the other cannot accept

required_authority: None. Shared assembly changes no mandate, no membership and no reporting line.
caveat: This is overlap in what the forums are sent, not in what they do. The differing cut-off dates are a separate traceability finding.
prohibited_inference: That shared evidence evidences shared purpose
That the 6 person-days can only be recovered by consolidating the forums
